title: flight-agent results artifact (v1)
description: Schema for out/flight_results_2027-07-17.json (D15), as produced by flightagent.reporting.json_report.build_results_document. v1 scope plus Phase 4's T26 failed_searches, Phase 5's T33 destination_analyses, Phase 6's T39 early_stop_analysis and T41's origin_comparison/self_transfer_rejections/top_itineraries_by_destination -- grow this schema alongside the writer, never ahead of it. data_source is a structural top-level field per master plan S8.6.

data_source.description: Master plan S8.6 (CRITICAL): mock output must carry this as a structural top-level field, never buried or optional.

accepted_count.description: Full valid-itinerary count before top-N truncation (D15).

top_n.description: The truncation limit applied when producing top_itineraries (D15's 'global top 10'). len(top_itineraries) <= top_n.

failed_searches.description: Phase 4 (T26): one entry per TaskOutcome whose state is an error state (PROVIDER_ERROR, RATE_LIMITED, TIMEOUT -- domain.run's _ERROR_STATES). Always present, empty when nothing failed.

destination_analyses.description: Phase 5 (T33), D10: one entry per registry destination -- the direct-vs-one-stop policy comparison (flightagent.policy.direct_vs_stop.analyze_destination). Always present; empty for the single --dest pipeline, which never computes it.

early_stop_analysis.description: Phase 6 (T39), D12: one entry per destination -- the post-hoc, deterministic replay of the EUR-threshold early-stop rule (flightagent.orchestration.waves.replay_early_stop). Purely an annotation; never changes top_itineraries or accepted_count. Always present; empty when not computed (e.g. the single --dest pipeline).

origin_comparison.description: Phase 6 (T41), master plan acceptance criterion A2-5c: one entry per configured origin (flightagent.scoring.origin_summary.summarize_by_origin). An origin with zero accepted itineraries still gets an entry, with cheapest_fare_eur/destination/itinerary_id null and reason naming why -- never a silently missing entry. Always present; empty for the single --dest/--origin pipeline, which never computes it.

self_transfer_rejections.description: Phase 6 (T41), D5: one entry per itinerary excluded specifically for a RejectionCode.SELF_TRANSFER rejection -- never present in top_itineraries (D5 excludes these from the valid ranked set entirely). Always present, empty when none occurred.

top_itineraries_by_destination.description: Phase 6 (T41), D15: 'top 3 per destination additionally in the JSON' (top_n from settings.output.top_n_per_destination). Keyed by destination IATA code, sorted alphabetically for determinism (finding 0.3); each value is a list of the same per-itinerary shape top_itineraries uses. Always present; an empty object when none were computed.

destination.description: Destination IATA code parsed from the failed task's task_id (domain.ids.compute_task_id's '{origin}-{destination}-sN' shape).

error_type.description: TaskOutcome.error_type -- the error class, e.g. 'circuit_open'. Null when the outcome carries no error classification.

error_detail.description: TaskOutcome.error_detail -- a short human-readable detail. Null when the outcome carries no detail.

price_eur.description: Money.amount, quantized to the cent -- always exactly two decimal places.

booking_url.description: Raw booking_url string as it appeared on the NormalizedItinerary, or null when none was present. May be present even when booking_url_valid is false -- see booking_url_valid.

booking_url_valid.description: Whether booking_url passed reporting.booking_link.validate_booking_url (master plan S8.2). false means booking_url must never be rendered as a clickable link.

scoreComponents.description: domain.scoring.ScoreComponents, each field as a decimal-shaped string (never a JSON number -- finding 0.3 forbids float round-tripping of money/score values).

destinationAnalysis.description: domain.policy.DestinationAnalysis, shaped for JSON (Phase 5, T33). airline/price_eur are null exactly when tier is not_available (no direct service exists); price_difference_eur/relative_difference are additionally null when a direct itinerary exists but no valid one-stop alternative does.

price_difference_eur.description: cheapest_direct minus cheapest_valid_stop, signed -- negative when the direct itinerary is actually the cheaper one.

recommendation.description: Addendum 1's exact Recommendation-column text (D10) -- plain text, no visual marker (the Markdown renderer adds a star for 'recommended' at render time only).

time_saved_minutes.description: cheapest_valid_stop.total_duration - cheapest_direct.total_duration, in whole minutes. Positive means the direct itinerary is faster; can legitimately be negative.

earlyStopEvaluation.description: domain.policy.EarlyStopEvaluation, shaped for JSON (Phase 6, T39). triggering_origin/margin_eur are null exactly when triggered is false. mode is always 'advisory' -- this codebase only ever builds the post-hoc replay (master plan S5's Option B); true sequential-priority execution ('enforced') is a separate, unbuilt code path.

compared_against.description: D12/master plan S4: the exact origin set this comparison used -- always present, possibly empty.

originComparisonEntry.description: domain.scoring.OriginSummary, shaped for JSON (Phase 6, T41, master plan A2-5c). cheapest_fare_eur/destination/itinerary_id are null exactly when this origin produced zero accepted itineraries, in which case reason names why (flightagent.reporting.view.origin_absence_reason); reason is null whenever a real fare is present.

ground_minutes.description: Whole minutes from OriginSummary.ground_minutes -- null when this origin has no accepted itinerary carrying a GroundLeg to read a duration off of.

destination.description: The destination this origin's cheapest itinerary flies to -- not a fixed target, since OriginSummary picks the single overall cheapest itinerary across every destination.

selfTransferRejection.description: One D5 self-transfer / separate-ticket itinerary excluded from the valid ranked set (Phase 6, T41) -- domain.validation.RejectedItinerary, shaped for JSON.

self_transfer_airports.description: IATA code(s) of every layover in this itinerary flagged Layover.is_self_transfer -- usually one entry, but D2's multi-leg shape leaves room for more.

reason.description: The Rejection.message that excluded this itinerary (rule_id='self_transfer').
